// why: The generated types had a real defect for two chapters: tsType() collected
nested enums but not nested records, so every schema with an array-of-record
field emitted `items: Array<ReservationLine>` with no ReservationLine
anywhere in the file. Nothing caught it, because nothing imported these
files and no tsconfig included them — they were documentation that happened
This config exists so `tsc --noEmit` compiles them. noEmit because these are
types only: there is nothing to build, only something to check.
